logo_url.description: URL or path to custom logo image. Can be a local file path or HTTP/HTTPS URL

logo_url_dark.description: URL or path to a custom logo image for dark mode. Can be a local file path or HTTP/HTTPS URL. Leave unset to reuse logo_url in dark mode

favicon_url.description: URL to custom favicon image. Must be an HTTP/HTTPS URL to a .ico, .png, or .svg file
